title: Inbox & CRM Hygiene
summary: Shared inbox triaged and the CRM kept truthful — every conversation logged, routed and followed up.

trigger.description: Message arrives in the shared inbox.

agents.name: triage
agents.role: Classifies every inbound message (lead / client / vendor / spam / urgent) and routes it.

agents.name: logger
agents.role: Logs conversation summaries and next steps against the right CRM contact and deal.

agents.name: data-steward
agents.role: Fixes stale CRM fields: dead deals flagged, owners assigned, duplicates proposed for merge.

agents.name: router
agents.role: Escalates anything urgent or ambiguous to the right human with a one-paragraph brief.

rollback: Disable the email.received trigger; labels and CRM notes written so far remain (all are additive). Merge proposals are queued, never auto-applied.
